== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Keeps per-turn deployment and per-game exchange, limits exchange to parsecs 1 through 8, replaces bounded Boring Conversation Anyway protection with general cannot be canceled, removes cancellation-prevention bypass while Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers is out. December/January/October wording variants same operative state.
